environment_scope: Full 2000-record accuracy passes only. Primary timing hosts are recorded separately in latency_environment.

corpus.annotation_caveat: Provided labels are not a fully audited human-gold dataset. Corpus has prior development/evaluation use; no new independent qualification claim.

native.order: Sequential models in fixture order; all ordered heldout inputs once per model
timer_includes: InferenceSession.run, input/output transport and owned output arrays
native.p95_method: Linear interpolation over 2000 warm execution samples

chrome.latency_scope: One warm execution per heldout input, after cold execution and four (or requested) warmups on input zero; no batching
timer_includes: Execute dispatch, input/output transport and copied inline slot logits
chrome.order: The same ordered heldout inputs once, sequentially within each model. The first ten models use one sequential driver; the final three model processes start concurrently while model ten completes.

execution_schedule.overlap: The final three model processes start while model ten completes. Each model processes the identical 2000 ordered inputs sequentially.
execution_schedule.handoff: The initial non-resume driver ends when mkdir encounters the existing model-eleven directory; this guard occurs before modifying that directory. Individual model reports are the completion authority.
execution_schedule.latency_scope: Local full-accuracy pass timings are auxiliary and include concurrent host load. Primary comparison uses separate serialized native and Chrome interleaved runs on the i3-1115G4 host.

native.input_selection: Fixed ordered positions 0,999,1999; no label/accuracy-based selection

protocol.comparison_scope: Primary native and Chrome model latency uses the same host, three heldout inputs, 15 cycles and alternating model order. split_audit.scope: Stored historical file/pixel hash manifests compared with the current heldout; source image bytes were not reread.
limitations: Audit coverage is partial. Empty model stage lists and historical-aggregate-only entries are not newly verified zero overlap.
Original FP32 pretraining is unaudited; no complete training-lifecycle leakage guarantee is claimed.
These frozen models were previously examined on the same corpus, so this is not an independent blind evaluation.
Historical QAT used real and synthetic data. No new training or calibration used the currently supplied training path.
Zero exact-file/pixel hash overlap does not establish semantic-scene or near-duplicate independence.

selection_scope: Existing compact default is marked; this evaluation does not retrain models or select a new checkpoint.
scoring: Record accuracy requires exact complete phone and street digits. Question accuracy counts each supplied question separately.
